svg.title: Daughter of the Reconcilers: the Bringer-Forth of life: Temperance (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Above, Sagittarius, the Key's attribution; below, the letter Samekh (ס); Key XIV, Path 25. Its ring: number 71 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1793160239773-2wn6stc7o4q.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
